summary:
Developed for deep space exploration, ISIS (Integração de Softwares de Indicadores de Saúde) is a 100% offline assistive executive support ecosystem. It addresses the severe challenges of astronaut isolation, communication delays of up to 20 minutes, chronic sleep deprivation, and cognitive overload by integrating advanced health hardware (Bio-Monitor, MicroPREP, Tempus Pro) with environmental computer vision and the local ISIS IA neuro-specialist chatbot.

To overcome decision paralysis and operational stress, ISIS uses a strict cognitive load filter aligned with W3C COGA guidelines, delivering one primary action per screen, alongside an automated Manchester-protocol triage system. Furthermore, its neuroscience-based anti-punishment architecture rewards honest symptom reporting and utilizes flexible streaks to prevent anxiety and symptom concealment.   

This project is vital because it guarantees absolute operational autonomy for crews beyond Earth, protecting mental and physical health, preventing performance degradation, and safeguarding mission success in extreme deep-space environments.
details:
ISIS (Integration of Health Indicators Software) is a 100% offline executive support ecosystem developed for deep space missions, such as crewed journeys to Mars. The solution was designed to mitigate the critical impacts of isolation, communication delays of up to 20 minutes with Earth, sleep deprivation, and decision collapse.

The fundamental pillars of the solution include:

  • Integrated Technological Ecosystem: Combines continuous telemetry from advanced aerospace hardware (such as the Bio-Monitor and MicroPREP), environmental computer vision for passive monitoring, and the ISIS AI chatbot operating in an isolated local core.
  • Cognitive Load Filter (W3C COGA): Adapts to crew fatigue and stress by displaying only one primary action per screen, while automated clinical triage (Manchester Protocol) immediately forwards critical alerts to the onboard medical officer, reinforcing that artificial intelligence acts strictly as support and never replaces human clinical judgment.
  • Neuroscience-Based Anti-Punishment Architecture: Encourages continuous adherence by rewarding the act of logging (where reporting a negative state scores the same as well-being to prevent symptom concealment) and replacing punitive metrics with self-care constellations and evolving 3D avatars.
  • Impact and Autonomy: Guarantees crew operational sovereignty in extreme environments, enables prolonged stays with total safety, and generates valuable terrestrial spin-offs for isolated bases and support for neurodivergent individuals.
